ns2:course.label: Economic Statistics II
ns2:course.description: (ECON 173) Continuation of ECON 202. Builds upon point and interval estimation as well as hypothesis testing skills first introduced in ECON 202. Utilizes a practical project format to extend the student skill set to include simple and multiple linear regression and time series techniques. Prerequisite: ECON 202; MATH 234 or equivalent.
